headline: PM to lay foundation of 2 ROBs, 1 underpass in JSR
content: Jamshedpur: Over two lakh residents of the suburbs and semi-rural areas in the southern peripheral of the urban circle will hopefully get succour from the frequent traffic snarls at the railway crossings. PM Narendra Modi will lay the foundation stones of road over bridge (ROB) at Govindpur and Barigora level crossings and an underpass at the Salgajhari level crossing on Monday.Telco resident and vehicle loan executive Shailesh Tiwary said, “The ROB at Barigora will give much relief to people, particularly the motorists and cyclists of Sundernagar, Paridih, and surrounding areas who take the route to reach Tata Motors, Tata Power, and the Nuvoco cement plant at Jojobera.” Similarly, the ROB at Govindpur will ease the travel woes of the people arriving in the the city from different parts of Potka, Jaduguda, Sarjamda, and adjoining places.The Salgajhari road underpass near the Tatanagar railway yard will benefit the people who use the stretch to reach Manifit, Jemco, and surrounding areas.Pursudih resident and trader Supriyo Bose said, “The three ROBs connects the residents of the fringe areas with the industrial town. These can also be called the linking bridges that connect the urban cricle to the rural and semi rural areas located in the peripheral areas.” Sometimes, ambulances get stuck at the level crossings, he added.Social and political outfits besides students’ groups have been demanding ROB at the three level crossings for around past eight years.“The three level crossings are located on the Tatanagar-Kharagpur rail route, which sees a high number of passenger and goods trains daily. Hence, the barriers are frequently lowered at the crossings, causing serpentine queues of vehicles,” said Chotanagpur Passengers’ Association president Arun Tiwari.The former deputy chairman of the zila parishad, Raj Kumar Singh, said over two lakh population living in the over 10 densely populated areas on the outskirts of the city will benefit from the ROBs. The areas are Sarjamda, Bawangora, Makdampur, Pursudih, Narwa, Jaduguda, Gadra, Asanboni, Khasmahal, and Sundernagar, he added.The senior divisional commercial manager of the Chakradharpur railway division, Garaj Singh Charan, said six road over bridges and four road under bridges have been approved in the division in the 2024-25 railway budget. Besides, six subways have also been identified, he stated. The railway will be spend Rs 1,000 crore in 40 projects, including the aforementioned ROB and underpass in Chakradharpur division in 2024-25.
